The Alameda County Registrar of Voters archived-elections index lists every county election of this year. None of them records an Oakland mayoral contest. The Nov 15, 2011 Oakland special election summary report lists only Measures H and I, no mayoral contest. Oakland City Charter (Municode, amended through December 3, 2024) Section 302 sets the Mayor's term at four years. Section 1101 holds General Municipal Elections in each even-numbered year, and Section 1102 limits other municipal elections to special elections. The county records show regular mayoral elections in 2010, 2014, 2018 and 2022, a four-year cycle.

The City of Oakland City Clerk list of qualified candidates for the November 3, 2026 election has a Mayor contest (Julius Robinson, Barbara Lee, Brenda F. Grisham, Mindy Ruth Pechenuk). The City Clerk elections page states the next City election is Tuesday, November 3, 2026. This date falls after the September 14, 2026 cutoff. The county elections page lists the June 2, 2026 primary and two special elections for the Congressional District 14 seat, and none has an Oakland mayoral contest. The county page gives no contest list for November 3, 2026, so the county page is not the source for the mayoral contest. Barbara Lee was elected in the April 15, 2025 special election to fill the term ended by the 2024 recall. No mayoral election falls inside the window in 2026.
